build_method: Option B (carousel-tile-generation.md): background plate generated with scripts/kie_image_gen.py (kie.ai gpt-image-2-text-to-image, feed at 3:4/2K, story at 9:16/2K) — a duotone shot of a relaxed man in a modern massage chair, gold key light. HTML/CSS overlay on top: bottom scrim, a service list (scissors + chair icons) and two glanceable pill chips at the foot — a solid-gold Q100 price chip and an outlined date chip with a small drawn calendar icon (all 30 September days marked gold) — instead of one large price number. Headless Chrome render at 2x. Price and every other digit set in Fira Sans Condensed ExtraBold (Lost in South has no digits 0/2/8).
